# Argentina BEN official page extracts

Retrieved 2026-11-15. These are lossless PDF page subsets produced from the
actual official downloads, not synthetic count tables. Their hashes differ from
the complete archived originals because irrelevant pages were removed for test
size. Source page headers and rendered source labels/counts are retained.

- `ben833_cover_eno.pdf`: original pages 1 and 9 from
  <https://www.argentina.gob.ar/sites/default/files/2026/01/ben_833_se_43_11112026-2.pdf>.
  Contains the 43-event ENO cumulative national table for 2026 SE43.
- `ben635_cover_eno.pdf`: original pages 1 and 53 (printed page 50) from
  <https://www.argentina.gob.ar/sites/default/files/2024/04/ben_635_se_1.pdf>.
  Contains the 2019–2022 Notif./Confi. retrospective table at SE52. Its official
  catalogue identifies BEN635, 2023 week 1; uploader path 2024 is not the fact year.
- `ben788_four_eno_tables.pdf`: original pages 1, 12, 13, 15 and 16 of BEN788,
  <https://www.argentina.gob.ar/sites/default/files/2025/01/ben_788_se_51_vf2.pdf>.
  It contains all four ENO table
  families: nominal confirmed; nominal notified/confirmed; clinical grouped;
  laboratory studied/positive.

The full original URL and checksum receipt for BEN788 remains in the local
archive manifest. No chart is digitized or cumulative snapshot differenced.
